format: Base Set (BS, 1999): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only.

abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another, as long as that doesn't Knock Out the Pokémon it's moved to. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

cards.name: Clefairy Doll
cards.text: Play Clefairy Doll as if it were a Basic Pokémon. While in play, it counts as a 10-HP Pokémon (instead of a Trainer card). It has no attacks, can't retreat, and can't be Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed or Poisoned. If it's Knocked Out, it doesn't count as a Knocked Out Pokémon. At any time during your turn before your attack, you may discard it.

cards.name: Computer Search
cards.text: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to look through your deck for any card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Devolution Spray
cards.text: Choose 1 of your evolved Pokémon in play and a Stage of Evolution. Discard all Evolution cards of that Stage or higher attached to that Pokémon. That Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed, Poisoned, or affected by anything else that might be the result of an attack (just as if you had evolved it).

cards.name: Item Finder
cards.text: Discard 2 of the other cards from your hand in order to put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Lass
cards.text: You and your opponent show each other your hands, then shuffle all the Trainer cards from your hands into your decks.

cards.name: Pokémon Breeder
cards.text: Put a Stage 2 card from your hand on the matching Basic Pokémon. You can only play this card when you would be allowed to evolve that Pokémon anyway.

cards.name: Pokémon Trader
cards.text: Trade 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards in your hand for 1 of the Basic Pokémon or Evolution cards from your deck. Show both cards to your opponent. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Scoop Up
cards.text: Choose 1 of your Pokémon in play and return its Basic Pokémon card to your hand. (Discard all cards attached to that card.)

cards.name: Super Energy Removal
cards.text: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon in order to choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon and up to 2 Energy cards attached to it. Discard those Energy cards.

cards.name: Defender
cards.text: Attach Defender to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard it at the end of your opponent's next turn. Any damage done to the Pokémon it's attached to by attacks is reduced by 20 (after Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Energy Retrieval
cards.text: Trade 1 of the other cards in your hand for up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile.

cards.name: Full Heal
cards.text: Your Active Pokémon is no longer Asleep, Confused, Paralyzed or Poisoned.

cards.name: PlusPower
cards.text: During this turn, your Pokémon's attacks do 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before Weakness and Resistance).

cards.name: Pokémon Flute
cards.text: Choose 1 Basic Pokémon card from your opponent's discard pile and put it onto their Bench. (You can't play Pokémon Flute if your opponent's Bench is full.)

cards.name: Professor Oak
cards.text: Discard your hand, then draw 7 cards.

cards.name: Revive
cards.text: Put 1 Basic Pokémon card from your discard pile onto your Bench. Put damage counters on that Pokémon equal to half its HP (rounded down to the nearest 10). (You can't play Revive if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Super Potion
cards.text: Discard 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your own Pokémon in order to remove up to 4 damage counters from that Pokémon.

cards.name: Bill
cards.text: Draw 2 cards.

cards.name: Gust of Wind
cards.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with their Active Pokémon.
